items.caption:
The Bible never says there were three wise men ✨ Matthew 2:1-12

It says wise men from the east followed His star, troubled King Herod, found the young child in a house in Bethlehem, worshipped Him and gave gold, frankincense and myrrh. Three gifts, but the number of men is never given.

Did you grow up hearing “three kings” in Sunday school? Yes or no 👇
